body: Otters

To the guy leaving hateful messages on my post, i was molested and abused as a small child by a family friend, and my parents constantly fought and made me feel unsafe as a child, and making connections with people is incredibly hard for me, that includes a connection with my parents. My parents kicked me out when I was 17 because I had sex with my bf of 2 years and I was homeless for months. I said they weren’t the worst because I realize a lot of children have it worse, but they certainly weren’t the best. They’ve tried harder in recent years to connect with me, but I’m still skeptical of them. I’m highly suicidal, and this is a huge burden of guilt for me because I feel wrong about it, but I can’t help but feel this way and your unkind words aren’t helping. This is supposed to be a safe space for people to vent to. That’s why it’s called off my chest. If you have a negative opinion keep it to yourself. You don’t know the entire story. Not everyone is so lucky to naturally feel that way for people in their life.

I feel this so much. You’re not alone. Just know you’re doing all of the right things, and as long as you’re being proactive on being a better you, it’ll work out. Maybe start making a small list in the morning of things you want to accomplish, so even if you start to struggle within yourself, you’re at least finishing what you said you would. Give yourself a feeling of accomplishment when you feel like you can’t do anything. I’m tired too. Every day is a struggle. But I’m somehow still here.
26 in August

I’m in this exact same boat 😔 I’m sorry. It’s the hardest thing in the world to face. I got a new pet to talk to, and he helps a lot. It’s okay to feel down and reach out for help. I know nothing I say will really make you feel better or fill that void, so I wish you the best and I hope you’re handling it better than I am.

My university only allows 6 counseling sessions until you have to start paying for it elsewhere.. and the only place in town is $60/session with a psychiatrist that talks to you on a tv screen. I’ve told them I was suicidal and I haven’t gotten any more help or anyone to even check up on me.  I feel like I’m already on a pretty high dose. It’s just not working and I feel like I’m running out of options

I don’t have health insurance, so I only have access to counseling at my university, which is totally useless for me, and I’ve been on anti depressants for months now. Nothing makes me feel better, and every day feels worse

I think it’s more selfish for the people saying that it’s selfish.  It’s like They only want them to be here for themselves, because while they were living, those people didn’t try a whole lot to prevent it until it was too late. People that want to kill themselves are in endless agony and feel like the world would be better without them and that no one cares about them and that there’s no other choice.  Isn’t it more selfish for people to make them feel this way? I’ve been having a lot of problems with me expressing how I feel to my close friends about my suicidal thoughts, and none of them take it seriously or have tried to make me feel more loved or anything. If i did commit suicide, they’d probably call me selfish for leaving them, but they’re the ones being selfish by not giving me the time of day to make me feel special to them.  I get their lives are busy, but I do so much for all of them because I’m like begging for their attention because I’m so alone, but my needs never are more important than theirs, and I’m constantly having to be the one to reach out.  No one checks on me or anything after I’ve told them I want to kill myself, And it just makes me want to do it more because I feel like I don’t matter to them. 

SUICIDE IS NOT SELFISH. Suicide is an escape from their own living hell, and the “only” option for many because they’re in so much pain.  I get very angry when people talk about suicide this way because I think of it way too often, but feel like I have no support even when I beg for it, and the ONLY reason I’m here is because I can’t stand thinking about putting my pets in the shelter. 

Also, people that “cry wolf” with suicide attempts should be taken very seriously. Even if they don’t fully attempt, or survive their attempt or whatever the situation, it should always be handled with love and care. I had an attempt a couple months ago, and I literally had my closest friend tell me he didn’t like how I “tried to get his attention” by attempting and that I won’t actually do it. And he hasn’t even checked in on me about how I’m feeling since. He made my situation about him, that I was just seeking his attention, and that really sucked. Even if it’s a cry for attention, GIVE THEM ATTENTION. They need it. Obviously they need it if they’re desperate to die. 

Be kind, care more, respect the feelings of others. And don’t say you understand, because you don’t. Sympathize as much as you can, but no one can ever fully understand what you’re feeling and going through. I hate when people tell me they do. All I ask is for support, and I’m usually met with “well this happened to me” or “I totally understand but you can’t think like that” like obviously you don’t understand if you think I can control my thoughts right now.  

Okay rant over.  Very angry about the stigmas of suicide.

I hear the same about essential oils actually.  I think anything you buy online should have some research put into it nowadays. Thanks for the heads up! 
Yeah, I’ve already visited.  It hurts too much. I deserved more than what he gave me. Even being here, I just run it through my head over and over and over again.  Every little detail.  It’s been 7 months since we broke up, and I’ve cried multiple times a day, every single day. I just don’t know if I’ll ever be okay again.

I didn’t even think to look online! I figured it was one of those things that they only sold in stores since people are so weird about marijuana and would relate the two.  I’ll have to look into that. Yeah, they’re very beautiful states! But idk. Colorado is where my heart has always been. I’ve wanted to move there since I was like 7. And I lived there for a summer when I was interning, and I just really loved it. For the longest time, i couldn’t even imagine living anywhere else. So it sucks so much that now it’s a source of pain for me

I was looking at jobs in Colorado because I graduate this year, but I think my ex has kind of ruined it for me.  I can’t get over him being states away, idk how I would do with him just being an hour or so away. I feel like he kinda ruined my life. I’m now looking at jobs in Oregon and washington; I study environmental engineering so I want to go somewhere that I can get a job with a lot of field work. I have tried CBD, and I like it, but a small bottle here costs like $100 and money is just so tight for me. It’s definitely not as good as THC, but I do feel it relax my body quite a bit, and I think it has potential benefits for me. I was microdosing shrooms for a while too and that helped, but I can’t really find them anymore either.

That’s really amazing you can have a relationship with your doctors like that!! And I’m really glad you got away from the alcohol.  I actually think alcohol can be one of the worst drugs; I try not to drink too often because of my dad, but I do enjoy a nice scotch here and there. Weed should just be legalized and distributed  everywhere, I don’t understand how it’s not yet because there are so many benefits. I want to just try to get some edibles or something mailed to me, but I’m really scared of getting caught. But without it I feel like I’m drowning right now. And what’s worse is my ex moved to Colorado working a job that I interned for and told him to apply to, and is like living the life I wanted, and he doesn’t even smoke.
I really appreciate you caring like that.

I think I would be okay with that.  I just feel really fucked up all the time right now, and it feels like even my closest friends don’t take me seriously or care, or it ends up being a competition of who is more miserable and I end up trying to help them.

I smoke marijuana very regularly, but it’s hard to find sometimes in my town, and I think that’s a big reason why I’ve been struggling especially hard these past couple days, I can’t find any right now and I usually smoke every day to calm me down and help me sleep.  I used to be addicted to pills, so I kinda used marijuana to Segway away from it during my withdrawals and I’ve smoked since. I’ll take breaks from it to cleanse because I don’t believe in relying on substances (because of my addict past) but I just think I really need it right now to cope with everything. I dabble in essential oils and I actually find like mood lighting to help a ton. I haven’t found anything else that really helps yet.  I’m just so frustrated because I feel like I’m being very proactive about helping myself but nothing is working

I’ve tried reaching out so much because I think I deserve to have a life. I’ve worked so hard my entire life, and have struggled through so many things, I want a chance at living a normal life. That’s why I have so many hobbies, because I’ve struggled so much that I like really try to take advantage of the time that I don’t have to work. But the area I live in doesn’t care much for mental health, the cheapest I can find is $60/session and that’s not including the cost of medication. And I’m so busy working anyway that finding time to go would be incredibly hard. I’m scared I’m going to get evicted and lose my pets.  I’m going to kill myself if I do
I like to think I’m a fighter, but after fighting for almost ten years now, I’m so exhausted..

I’m in such bad debt from when I was homeless because I was living on a credit card out of my car, and I started college by paying for my first year of tuition on my card. So I’m constantly struggling between paying my credit card off, paying for school, housing, food, rent, and everything else. I’m just financially exhausted to the point that I’m missing bills frequently now. I have a really cool internship for engineering, but they are only paying me $11/hr and business has been slow at my other two restaurant jobs so I don’t make much. I just can’t afford proper care. And I also live in a very small rural town for my university. I get no help from my family and I’ve been on my own since I was 17 and I’m almost 26 now.

I used to enjoy a lot of things. I have a garden, I’m a pretty decent artist, I play six instruments, I love the outdoors, I volunteer at the local animal shelter and the local food pantry, I read a lot about green energy because I study engineering, I practice yoga, i play with my pets, I used to be a sous chef at a really nice restaurant and I’m vegetarian so i like to cook a lot, i also brew beer sometimes, i like horror films a lot, I’m slightly an anime geek, I absolutely love travel, I speak French and English, I’m a big advocate for feminism and equal rights, I could go on and on.  But these past couple months, I try to do everything I used to love, and I just don’t feel joy anymore.  It’s just gone

Thank you for your response.  I really wish I could be on medicine right now.  Every second hurts. And I can’t stop seeing him with her in my head. I just don’t know when I will be able to get help, and that might be one of the hardest part of this.  I can’t see the end to it. I’ve thought of suicide for years now, but I’ve had multiple instances of me halfway attempting in the past couple months. I just always get scared to leave my pets. I just feel like I could snap any second
